propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment truncation at 32767 chars, ignoring the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property which ranges from 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647

when a Jira DC administrator raises or removes the comment ceiling above 32767, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept in full, causing data loss and divergence between local and remote bodies
the hardcoded 32767 default is correct for stock Jira >= 7.0 but wrong for configured instances, creating a data-loss window only for admins who have changed the limit
sanitize_comment couples to the description fitter via shared truncation logic, creating a latent trap where future changes to description fitting could catastrophically break comment handling
the DC comment ceiling must be made configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars, defaulting to 32767 with provenance cited, allowing operators to match their instance's admin setting
